description: This file contains implementation code for Wi-Fi radio interface management, including VAP and endpoint creation, BSSID handling, MAC address shifting, and interface name generation within a wireless networking project.

methods.name: int s_applyMac(T_SSID * pSSID,int ifIndex,char * ifName)
methods.description: Apply a MAC address to a given SSID and interface.

methods.name: bool s_getNewVapIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_SSID * pSSID,int if_count,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generate a new VAP interface name based on existing radio and SSID info.

methods.name: bool s_updateVapIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,const char * vapIfName)
methods.description: Update the VAP interface name in the AccessPoint structure.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_createAp(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Create and initialize a new AccessPoint (VAP) on the radio.

methods.name: int s_apIfIndex(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Calculate the interface index for an AccessPoint.

methods.name: uint32_t s_apMacIndex(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Calculate the MAC index for an AccessPoint.

methods.name: void s_updateAllMacs(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Update MAC addresses for all endpoints and VAPs on a radio after a MAC shift.

methods.name: void s_applyAllMacs(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Reapply MAC addresses to all endpoints and VAPs, particularly after changes.

methods.name: void s_checkAndProcessMbssBMacChange(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t apMacIndex)
methods.description: Check and process changes in Multi-BSS MAC configuration and shift MACs if needed.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_addVapExt(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Add a VAP (Virtual Access Point) interface to a radio, including generating a unique name, MAC, and initializing the interface.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_delvapif(T_Radio * pRad,char * vapName)
methods.description: Delete a VAP interface based on its name.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_generateEpIfName(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t ifaceShift _UNUSED,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generate an Endpoint interface name based on the radio's main interface.

methods.name: bool s_getNewEpIfaceName(T_Radio * pRad,T_SSID * pSSID,int if_count,char * ifName,size_t ifNameSize)
methods.description: Generate a new Endpoint interface name, with custom override if provided.

methods.name: int wifiGen_rad_addEndpointIf(T_Radio * pRad,char * buf,int bufsize)
methods.description: Create a new endpoint interface on a radio, handling MAC assignment and interface configuration.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wifiGen_rad_delendpointif(T_Radio * pRad _UNUSED,char * endpoint)
methods.description: Delete an endpoint interface based on its name.

methods.name: int wifiGen_vap_bssid(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,unsigned char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Get or set the BSSID for a VAP, with support for string and binary MAC formats.
